reason: I'll add the receiving branches to the cell bodies first; their locator shows where they belong.
expectation: I expect the branches to attach around the cell bodies, helping them receive messages.

alternatives.reason: The channels also have a clear place in the fibre membrane, but I want to build the receiving side first.

effect: The receiving branches are attached, and the long extensions still need to be added and fitted with channels.
reaction: The continuous membrane makes the branches feel like part of the same cell.
reason: I'll fit the channels into the fibres first, as the picture shows spaces for them in the membrane.
expectation: I expect the channels to fit into the fibre membranes, where they can let charged particles through.

alternatives.reason: I could attach the fibres to the cells first, but preparing their channels also directly serves a goal.

effect: The channels are fitted, and their opening in sequence helps explain how an electrical change moves along a fibre. Next I need to join the cell parts.
reaction: It was surprising that no single charged particle has to travel the whole length.
reason: This is the only offered combination and directly matches the new goal.
expectation: I expect the prepared long extensions to join the cells with receiving branches.

effect: The completed cells join the receiving branches and channel-equipped extensions, and show chemical messengers crossing a gap to another cell.
reaction: The separate membranes at the contact helped me see that the cells pass messages without joining together.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the channels was most worthwhile because the result showed how an electrical change travels along the fibre without one particle making the whole trip.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the receiving branches was straightforward but less revealing than seeing how the channels work.

surprise.text: I was surprised that no single charged particle has to travel the whole length of the fibre.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary: the pictures and goals showed where the parts belonged. The final joining was also the only offered combination.

continue.text: I would continue, because seeing the electrical change travel and then chemical messengers cross to another cell made me curious about what happens next.
